sources.label: Morphe patches for Samsung Health on Knox-tripped Galaxy devices
sources.author: Bigyank Samsung
patch_list: Replaces com.osp.app.signin with com.notsamsung.dummy in dex and routes account lookups through Android AccountManager instead of Samsung Account's provider.
Bypass Knox, root, warranty bit, and SAK checks so Samsung Health runs on Knox-tripped devices (0x1) without root.
Removes the Discover+ advertising card from the home screen by replicating the app's own offline early-exit in the promotion load path. No-ops on builds without the promotion package.
